name: Queen's Court: A Duel of Dignitaries
summary: Step into the elegant world of Queen's Court: A Duel of Dignitaries, where strategic prowess and refined cunning reign supreme. Compete against fellow dignitaries in a battle of wits and card play to achieve the lowest spread between your royal piles. Claim victory in this captivating blend of regal intrigue and gentlemanly competition! This fast paced card game will immerse you in a world of rivalries and tactical brilliance, where every calculated move shapes the outcome. The path to victory lies in mastering the art of card management and offensive strategic card play.
